offering_description.value: STERIS makes sterilization and disinfection equipment, consumables, and procedural devices for hospitals and surgery centers. It operates contract sterilization facilities for medical device manufacturers. It also supplies contamination control equipment, consumables, and services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers.

primary_products.value: Sterilizers and washer-disinfectors; detergents, disinfectants, and sterility indicators; endoscopy devices and accessories; surgical tables and lights; cleanroom decontamination systems

primary_services.value: Surgical instrument repair; equipment maintenance; outsourced sterile processing; contract sterilization; laboratory testing and validation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, surgery centers, endoscopy clinics, medical device manufacturers, and pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies; B2G: Government-operated hospitals and health systems

end_markets.value: Hospital and outpatient care; medical device manufacturing; pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Sterilization and surgical equipment, endoscopy devices, and recurring consumables; service fees: Instrument repair, equipment maintenance, and laboratory testing; project or contract: Contract sterilization for manufacturers and outsourced sterile processing for healthcare facilities
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns purchased materials and components into equipment, instruments, and consumables for healthcare facilities and life sciences manufacturers; service provider: Repairs instruments and equipment for healthcare facilities and tests products for device and drug manufacturers; asset operator: Operates sterilization facilities that process products supplied by medical device and pharmaceutical manufacturers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Healthcare infection prevention and procedural equipment, contract sterilization, and life sciences contamination control

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and service teams for healthcare systems and manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Medical and laboratory equipment distributors in selected markets; own locations: Company-operated sterilization facilities and testing laboratories
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA medical device requirements, EPA registration for certain disinfectants, and radiation licensing for irradiation facilities
